command:
set -eu
cd /srv/legacy2/transactional-schema-upgrade
test_root=$(mktemp -d /tmp/catalog-upgrade-test.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf -- "$test_root"' EXIT INT TERM
mkdir -p "$test_root/failure/bin" "$test_root/repeat/bin"
cp bin/upgrade.py "$test_root/failure/bin/upgrade.py"
cp bin/upgrade.py "$test_root/repeat/bin/upgrade.py"
python3 - "$test_root" <<'PY'
import pathlib, sqlite3, sys
schema = pathlib.Path('schema.sql').read_text()
for case in ('failure', 'repeat'):
    con = sqlite3.connect(pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1], case, 'catalog.db'))
    con.executescript(schema)
    if case == 'failure':
        con.execute("""CREATE TRIGGER fail_version_update
                       BEFORE UPDATE ON schema_version
                       BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'injected final-step failure'); END""")
    con.commit()
    con.close()
PY
set +e
"$test_root/failure/bin/upgrade.py" >"$test_root/failure.out" 2>&1
failure_rc=$?
set -e
printf 'injected_failure_exit=%s\n' "$failure_rc"
[ "$failure_rc" -ne 0 ]
tail -n 3 "$test_root/failure.out"
python3 - "$test_root/failure/catalog.db" <<'PY'
import sqlite3, sys
con=sqlite3.connect(sys.argv[1])
columns=[r[1] for r in con.execute('PRAGMA table_info(products)')]
print('rollback_integrity=', con.execute('PRAGMA integrity_check').fetchone()[0])
print('rollback_version=', con.execute('SELECT version FROM schema_version').fetchall())
print('rollback_columns=', columns)
print('rollback_products=', con.execute('SELECT id,description FROM products ORDER BY id').fetchall())
assert columns == ['id', 'description']
assert con.execute('SELECT version FROM schema_version').fetchall() == [(1,)]
assert con.execute('SELECT id,description FROM products ORDER BY id').fetchall() == [(1,'Paper'),(2,'Tape')]
PY
"$test_root/repeat/bin/upgrade.py"
"$test_root/repeat/bin/upgrade.py"
python3 - "$test_root/repeat/catalog.db" <<'PY'
import sqlite3, sys
con=sqlite3.connect(sys.argv[1])
print('repeat_integrity=', con.execute('PRAGMA integrity_check').fetchone()[0])
print('repeat_version=', con.execute('SELECT version FROM schema_version').fetchall())
print('repeat_products=', con.execute('SELECT id,description,price_cents FROM products ORDER BY id').fetchall())
assert con.execute('SELECT version FROM schema_version').fetchall() == [(2,)]
assert con.execute('SELECT id,description,price_cents FROM products ORDER BY id').fetchall() == [(1,'Paper',0),(2,'Tape',0)]
try:
    con.execute("INSERT INTO products(id,description,price_cents) VALUES(99,'invalid',-1)")
except sqlite3.IntegrityError as exc:
    print('negative_price_rejected=', type(exc).__name__)
else:
    raise AssertionError('negative price was accepted')
con.rollback()
PY

cd /srv/legacy2/transactional-schema-upgrade

./bin/upgrade.py

python3 - <<'PY'
import sqlite3
con=sqlite3.connect('catalog.db')
print('integrity_check=', con.execute('PRAGMA integrity_check').fetchone()[0])
print('schema_version=', con.execute('SELECT version FROM schema_version').fetchall())
print('products_sql=', con.execute("SELECT sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='products'").fetchone()[0])
print('table_info=', con.execute('PRAGMA table_info(products)').fetchall())
print('products=', con.execute('SELECT id,description,price_cents FROM products ORDER BY id').fetchall())

assert con.execute('SELECT id,description,price_cents FROM products ORDER BY id').fetchall() == [(1,'Paper',0),(2,'Tape',0)]
con.execute('BEGIN')
try:
    con.execute("INSERT INTO products(id,description,price_cents) VALUES(99,'invalid',-1)")
except sqlite3.IntegrityError as exc:
    print('negative_price_rejected=', type(exc).__name__)
else:
    raise AssertionError('negative price was accepted')
finally:
    con.rollback()
print('products_after_constraint_test=', con.execute('SELECT id,description,price_cents FROM products ORDER BY id').fetchall())
con.close()
